items.source: Creates a new instance with the given URL patterns.
items.translation: 使用给定的 URL 模式创建新实例。

items.source: It is assumed that both instances have been obtained via getMatchingCondition(ServerWebExchange) to ensure they contain only patterns that match the request and are sorted with the best matches on top.
items.translation: 假设这两个实例均通过 `getMatchingCondition(ServerWebExchange)` 获取，以确保它们仅包含匹配请求的模式，且最佳匹配项排在最前。

items.source:
Combine the patterns of the current and of the other instances as follows:
  • If only one instance has patterns, use those.
  • If both have patterns, combine patterns from "this" instance with patterns from the other instance via PathPattern.combine(PathPattern).
  • If neither has patterns, use "" and "/" as root path patterns.
items.translation:
按以下方式合并当前实例与其他实例的模式：
  • 如果只有一个实例具有模式，则使用该模式。
  • 如果两者都具有模式，则通过 PathPattern.combine(PathPattern) 将“this"实例的模式与其他实例的模式合并。
  • 如果两者都不具有模式，则使用 "" 和 "/" 作为根路径模式。

items.source: Return the mapping paths that are not patterns.
items.translation: 返回非模式的映射路径。

items.source:
Checks if any of the patterns match the given request and returns an instance
that is guaranteed to contain matching patterns, sorted.
items.translation: 检查是否有任何模式匹配给定的请求，并返回一个保证包含匹配模式的实例，且已排序。
